g.text: batch-conductor (hourly CronJob) - the chain: checkpoint → compact → rollups → profile-builder → privacy
Compaction - runs IN the pipeline's process (single-writer rule)
Per-table buffer (batch size or flush interval)
decode (magic-byte sniff) - validate - normalise (manifest field map)
rejected rows persist to <provider>/rejected/ + onboarding_runs row
DuckDB delta_scan (resolves active file set from the log)
NDJSON actions - protocol / metaData / add / remove
profile_signals rows (+ PG memberships, match rate)
write Parquet (one file per day spanned)
bin-pack per partition (old days stay immutable)
one atomic commit (add survivor file + removes)
